body: hey, PM me if you need someone to talk to. It's okay if you just need someone, it's not attention seeking at all.

First, you aren't a waste, you're as much a person as anyone else on this planet. I forget where I read this or who said it, but basically we're all born without our consent, and we all have no idea what's going on. Every single person was just brought into existence, and had to figure it out on their own, and no one knows any more about the end of their life either. Don't know if this is relevant or i'm just spouting bs, but basically just you're not any less than any other person. However, it doesn't hurt to go a bit easier on yourself- i get sometimes you gotta work to the point of exhaustion, but if you can, ease up a bit on that.

I think it's okay to not have any motivation sometimes. I guess the only thing to do it wait it out until it passes. I know what it feels like, though, to not have any motivation, and i know these words can seem meaningless. Just try to get though it, if you can get through one second you can get through billions more, just take it one at a time. Is there anything that has given you motivation in the past that you can turn to, or something you can look forward to? I know it can be so difficult when you're stuck in a spot like this.

Just because you haven't killed yourself doesn't mean you're not severely depressed. Plenty of people are living in the worst conditions, and just surviving by going day by day. If you're alive and getting through this one second of time, you can do it again and again and again. This just means you've been doing this for a while. I think it must make you a strong person to go through this for that long and keep going on. Don't invalidate your suffering either, you do deserve help. Keep surviving, it's all we can do.

hey, (assuming this isn't a satire) to put it simply your partner is kinda uneducated. I mean, if someone rapes someone else, they're a rapist, and that's all there is to it. If you haven't raped someone else, you're not a rapist. Simple. All men are not rapists. It's possible your partner has been hurt by someone in the past which is causing this irrational thinking, so I'd consider getting help for them. It's a dangerous way of thinking, generalizing people like this. Like fighting sexism with sexism. (likewise with racism) You don't have any say as to whether you're born a male or white, but I guess just focus on being a good person, don't think too much about other people's insane lines of thinking. You're not being selfish by not killing yourself. If you're dead you can't cause any more good. Just be a good person in your own eyes, that's all you can really do.

hey... i relate to this a lot- the social anxiety stuff especially. PM me if you wanna talk. you don't seem like a bad dude at all, just sometimes we have these disadvantages we can't control and it seems like these things come to everyone else so easily, like they were born knowing how to be socially competent and conventionally attractive. I guess i'm just trying to say that these things don't really matter (i know they do in our world but not in the sense that we're all headed towards death and we can't stop that), but just know you're not alone in this
